cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.menu.desc: Whip motion along a chain of parts (tail, hair, wing): each bone repeats the previous one a little later
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.title: Make a wave
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.intro: Each bone repeats the previous one a little later, like a whip.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.needAnimate: Switch to Animate mode and pick (or create) the animation the wave goes into.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.needGroup: Select the first bone of the chain in the outliner (e.g. tail1).
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.branch.title: The chain splits
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.branch.text: The chain splits at '%s'. Which way should the wave go?
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.branch.label: Follow
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.tooManyBones: The chain has more than %d bones: only the first %d are used.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.followSrc: In 'Follow' mode the 1st part (%s) is the source: its motion stays as it is and the other bones copy it with a delay.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.waves.desc: Whole numbers only, so the loop closes without a jump.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.tipMore.desc: The tip moves up to 2x more than the 1st bone.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.replace: These bones already have rotation in this animation and it will be replaced: %s
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.notLoop: This animation does not loop: in game the wave plays only once.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.err.noBones: Tick at least one bone to receive the wave.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.err.noSrcKeys: The 1st part (%s) has no rotation in this animation yet. Animate it first or use 'New wave'.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.err.length: The length must be between 0.05 and 32.7 seconds.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.err.waves: Waves per animation: 1 to %d (at most 64 keyframes per bone).
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.err.frames: Not possible: the animation would have %d frames in game (CPM allows 255). Use fewer waves, or put the wave in a separate animation.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.err.duration: Not possible: the animation would last %s s (CPM allows 32.7 s).
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.warn.molang: %d formula (Molang) keyframes of the 1st part were skipped.
cpmplus.w4anim2.wave.warn.dropped: %d keyframes went past the end of the animation (it does not loop) and were cut.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.menu.desc: Copies the part to the other side of the body, mirrored and attached to the right body part, with names, 'copy transform' and item slots fixed
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.title: Mirror to the other side
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.intro: Copies '%s' to the other side of the body, mirrored.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.name: New name
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.target.desc: The body part it follows in game.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.target.create: %s (will be created, it does not exist yet)
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.copy.desc: Unticked: the part itself moves to the other side (no copy).
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.rename: Swap left↔right in the names (children too)
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.texNote: The texture is the same as the original, mirrored.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.warn.extrude: %d extruded cubes: the extrude texture cut-out is not mirrored. Check it in game.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.warn.link: '%s' copies the transform of '%s', which has no pair on the other side: it keeps following '%s'.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.warn.slot: Another part already has the item slot '%s': the item will show twice in game.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.warn.rotParent: The part was inside '%s', which is rotated, and its pair was not found: the copy goes directly into '%s' and may end up tilted. Check it.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.block.none: Select the part (group or cube) to mirror in the outliner.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.block.many: Select only one part (one group or one cube).
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.block.root: '%s' is a whole body part. To copy a body part use 'Duplicate body part'.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.block.noRoot: '%s' is not inside a body part (e.g. left_arm). Drag it into one first.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.block.unknownRoot: '%s' is not a body part CPM knows: the other side is unknown.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.block.animate: Switch back to Edit mode to mirror parts.
cpmplus.w4anim2.mirror.created: Created the body part '%s' (it did not exist).
